sourceNote: Printed page 77: a full-page map “نقشہ فتحِ مکہ”, redrawn schematically with its legend (hill, built-up area, road, direction of movement of the armies). Several small place names on the map (including the names of the gates and the hills) are too small to read with confidence; only the legible names are given and the positions are approximate. A thumb at the lower right is excluded. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
